description:
The Scheme for Capacity Building in Textile Sector (SCIS) aims to enhance the skill set of workers in the textile sector. 

It focuses on improving the overall productivity and competitiveness of the industry. 

The objectives include providing training to workers and enhancing their employability. 

Benefits include financial assistance for training programs and skill development initiatives. 

Eligibility criteria typically include individuals seeking employment in the textile sector. 

The application process involves submitting an application to designated training institutions or agencies. 

The timeline for training programs may vary based on the specific courses offered. 

Implementing authorities include the Ministry of Textiles and affiliated training organizations. 

The scheme is part of the larger initiative to promote skill development in various sectors of the economy.
